fall_predicate.nominal_pelvis_z_source: mean pelvis height of the nominal run between 2 s and 6 s, measured once (0.7697 m) and rounded

quantities.tilt: arccos(-g_z) with g the projected gravity in the pelvis frame, the same quantity the policy observes

fall_predicate.rule: FELL when pelvis height data.qpos[2] < 0.462 m (= 0.6 x the measured nominal standing height 0.77 m) OR pelvis tilt from vertical > 60.0 deg, whichever first, checked at the end of every 20 ms control tick

severity_proxy.definition: magnitude of the pelvis body's world-frame linear velocity at the first contact between the floor and a geom that does not belong to a foot body, after the predicate has fired
severity_proxy.secondary_definition: largest control-tick finite difference of that velocity after the predicate fired

fall_predicate.why_ours: Unitree's deploy_mujoco.py runner has no failure or health flag of its own; it steps until the clock runs out

initial_state_check.initial_state: the model's qpos0 (pelvis at 0.793 m, joints at zero), as deploy_mujoco.py starts it; the LSTM memory reset to zero

published_conditions.prose: conditions the policy's publisher deploys it under; None means the publisher states nothing about that axis

mutations.note: no other model field is written; mass scaling multiplies body_inertia by the same factor; the timestep is set to the publisher's own value

target.label: Unitree G1 walking policy (unitree_rl_gym motion.pt, 12-dof MuJoCo G1)

policy.architecture: PolicyExporterLSTM: LSTM(47->64) memory, Linear(64,32)/ELU/Linear(32,12) actor; stateful hidden/cell buffers reset per run
policy.evaluation: torch.jit.load, eval(), CPU, one thread, inference_mode, float32; no sampling, no dropout

licence.source: LICENSE file at the root of the repository, vendored as assets/LICENSE.unitree_rl_gym
licence.what_this_project_does: the policy file, the deployment configuration, the 12-dof MJCF and the 27 meshes it references are vendored verbatim with the licence text; nothing is modified; the sha256 of every file is checked at load time and published in every run document

policy.published_performance: none stated by the publisher; the deployment configuration is the only published operating point

target.trained_by: Unitree Robotics (the policy's publisher); nothing in this project trains or fine-tunes anything
